{{Quote|My father couldn't even close his eyes. Tears ran down his cheek, but his arms and his legs kept jittering. He couldn't get up. The stormtroopers dragged him and my mother out.|Kyp Durron, describing how his parents were arrested|<ref name="Dark Apprentice" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' was a [[Politics/Legends|politician]] and with his female [[Kyp Durron's mother|spouse]], was [[Parent/Legends|father]] to the eventual [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kyp Durron]] and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Zeth Durron]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="1 ABY"> According to ''[[Jedi Search]]'' [[Kyp Durron]] was eight when he and his [[Parent/Legends|parents]] were arrested by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. Since he is eighteen in [[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']], which was set in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', the [[Durron family]] must have been arrested in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].</ref> the [[Durron family]] was arrested by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for the parents' anti-Imperial opinions. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Death date" /> both of Kyp's parents were [[Death/Legends|executed]] at the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]].<ref name="Jedi Search" />
